entries.summary: 建立 main 下的事件配置块，创建各事件模块的配置并在 events 上下文解析块内指令，随后执行事件配置初始化。

defaults.text: events 是显式事件配置块，不存在自动补出的默认 events 块或标量默认值；缺少该块时，事件模块初始化报 no "events" section in configuration。块内 worker_connections 等有各自默认值，不能代替块头默认。

inheritance.text: 只在 main 建立唯一事件配置上下文；回调拒绝重复块，创建各事件模块配置、解析并逐个 init_conf，不执行父子 events 的 merge。块内配置的初始化不等于 events 块继承。

limitations.text: 同一配置不能重复建立 events 块；它是块指令，没有分号结尾的普通参数列表。

patch_status.note: 对固定发行版34项有效补丁回放逐段核对：本条所列配置入口、功能对象及限制保持；不把这一局部结论推广为完整事件循环、进程生命周期或实际环境未受影响。

entries.summary: 在 events 中控制普通 accept handler 一次通知是否继续尝试接收多个连接。非 kqueue 时，off 完成一次成功接收后结束循环，on 继续尝试；EAGAIN 会退出，其他错误是否继续取决于错误类型和可用数量。默认 off。

defaults.text: off（multi_accept = 0）。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块配置，无 server/location 层继承。

limitations.text: 参数只允许 on/off（不区分大小写），重复设置被拒绝；不能在 HTTP/stream 的 server 块内配置。
kqueue 使用事件提供的 available 数量并在循环中递减，不用本项覆盖该数量；Windows IOCP 走独立 acceptex handler。不能把 on 解释为所有平台都保证一次接收全部待连接。
accept4 返回 ENOSYS 时关闭 use_accept4 并继续，以 accept 回退；ECONNABORTED 在必要时递减 kqueue 的 available，仍非零则继续。不能把所有错误概括为立即退出。
有效 socket_cloexec 补丁为 accept4 增加 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在相应平台的 accept 后路径设置 FD_CLOEXEC；失败会关闭连接并返回。本站不根据此开关判断公平性或性能。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁逐项核所列 accept 消费与入口边界：socket_cloexec 直接给 accept4 增 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在 !inherited_nonblocking、非 IOCP、NGX_HAVE_FD_CLOEXEC 条件下加入 ngx_cloexec，失败清理后返回，保持 affected。available 和循环条件未变；ENOSYS 的 continue 仍检查循环尾，不能保证 off 非 kqueue 同次立即 fallback。未展开整个事件调度、UDP 或业务处理。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 基础事件模块中注册无独立编译 guard；实际效果依赖事件后端，kqueue/IOCP 不按普通非 kqueue accept 循环解释；目标环境未核实。

<directive name="multi_accept">
<syntax><literal>on</literal> | <literal>off</literal></syntax>
<default>off</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
If <literal>multi_accept</literal> is disabled, a worker process
will accept one new connection at a time.
Otherwise, a worker process
will accept all new connections at a time.
<note>
The directive is ignored if <link doc="events.xml" id="kqueue"/>
connection processing method is used, because it reports
the number of new connections waiting to be accepted.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 在 events 中设置每个普通 worker 的连接资源池大小，默认 512。配置值写入事件配置和 cycle->connection_n，用来分配连接对象及读写事件数组；不是只计客户端连接。

defaults.text: 512；由 DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS 初始化，而不是示例配置中的数值。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块中配置，不从 HTTP/stream 的 server/location 继承；未设置时使用事件配置默认值。

limitations.text: 只接受一个十进制数字参数；重复、非数字或超出 ngx_int_t 范围会被拒绝。配置初始化还要求至少容纳每个监听 socket 和一个 channel 连接；数值解析成功不代表配置可启动。
客户端、上游和监听连接均使用连接资源；不能将 worker_processes × worker_connections 直接当可服务客户端数。非 Windows 初始化会检查文件描述符资源限制，超出时记录警告，不由本项自动提高限制。
OpenResty privileged agent 的连接池使用独立 privileged_agent_connections 字段，而非本项；本站未核实目标环境资源和实际并发容量。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁对照普通 worker 数组分配、监听/客户端/上游取槽、回收和归还：reuseport_close_unused_fds 直接改变新增监听消费的非本 worker 分支，先 close、失败 EMERG、置 fd=-1 再 continue，因此标记已核对补丁影响；连接数组数量与旧配置事实不变。上游仅核53–64共享取槽，不展开受 socket_cloexec 修改的完整 socket/flags 路径；agent 使用独立连接数。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 固定源码的 ngx_event_core_module 列入基础事件模块，注册无独立编译 guard；初始化仍需可用事件后端，实际二进制与资源限制未核实。

<directive name="worker_connections">
<syntax><value>number</value></syntax>
<default>512</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that
can be opened by a worker process.
</para>

<para>
It should be kept in mind that this number includes all connections
(e.g. connections with proxied servers, among others),
not only connections with clients.
Another consideration is that the actual number of simultaneous
connections cannot exceed the current limit on
the maximum number of open files, which can be changed by
<link id="worker_rlimit_nofile"/>.
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 建立 main 下的事件配置块，创建各事件模块的配置并在 events 上下文解析块内指令，随后执行事件配置初始化。

defaults.text: events 是显式事件配置块，不存在自动补出的默认 events 块或标量默认值；缺少该块时，事件模块初始化报 no "events" section in configuration。块内 worker_connections 等有各自默认值，不能代替块头默认。

inheritance.text: 只在 main 建立唯一事件配置上下文；回调拒绝重复块，创建各事件模块配置、解析并逐个 init_conf，不执行父子 events 的 merge。块内配置的初始化不等于 events 块继承。

limitations.text: 同一配置不能重复建立 events 块；它是块指令，没有分号结尾的普通参数列表。

entries.summary: 在 events 中控制普通 accept handler 一次通知是否继续尝试接收多个连接。非 kqueue 时，off 完成一次成功接收后结束循环，on 继续尝试；EAGAIN 会退出，其他错误是否继续取决于错误类型和可用数量。默认 off。

defaults.text: off（multi_accept = 0）。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块配置，无 server/location 层继承。

limitations.text: 参数只允许 on/off（不区分大小写），重复设置被拒绝；不能在 HTTP/stream 的 server 块内配置。
kqueue 使用事件提供的 available 数量并在循环中递减，不用本项覆盖该数量；Windows IOCP 走独立 acceptex handler。不能把 on 解释为所有平台都保证一次接收全部待连接。
accept4 返回 ENOSYS 时关闭 use_accept4 并继续，以 accept 回退；ECONNABORTED 在必要时递减 kqueue 的 available，仍非零则继续。不能把所有错误概括为立即退出。
有效 socket_cloexec 补丁为 accept4 增加 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在相应平台的 accept 后路径设置 FD_CLOEXEC；失败会关闭连接并返回。本站不根据此开关判断公平性或性能。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁逐项核所列 accept 消费与入口边界：socket_cloexec 直接给 accept4 增 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在 !inherited_nonblocking、非 IOCP、NGX_HAVE_FD_CLOEXEC 条件下加入 ngx_cloexec，失败清理后返回，保持 affected。available 和循环条件未变；ENOSYS 的 continue 仍检查循环尾，不能保证 off 非 kqueue 同次立即 fallback。未展开整个事件调度、UDP 或业务处理。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 基础事件模块中注册无独立编译 guard；实际效果依赖事件后端，kqueue/IOCP 不按普通非 kqueue accept 循环解释；目标环境未核实。

<directive name="multi_accept">
<syntax><literal>on</literal> | <literal>off</literal></syntax>
<default>off</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
If <literal>multi_accept</literal> is disabled, a worker process
will accept one new connection at a time.
Otherwise, a worker process
will accept all new connections at a time.
<note>
The directive is ignored if <link doc="events.xml" id="kqueue"/>
connection processing method is used, because it reports
the number of new connections waiting to be accepted.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 在 events 中设置每个普通 worker 的连接资源池大小，默认 512。配置值写入事件配置和 cycle->connection_n，用来分配连接对象及读写事件数组；不是只计客户端连接。

defaults.text: 512；由 DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS 初始化，而不是示例配置中的数值。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块中配置，不从 HTTP/stream 的 server/location 继承；未设置时使用事件配置默认值。

limitations.text: 只接受一个十进制数字参数；重复、非数字或超出 ngx_int_t 范围会被拒绝。配置初始化还要求至少容纳每个监听 socket 和一个 channel 连接；数值解析成功不代表配置可启动。
客户端、上游和监听连接均使用连接资源；不能将 worker_processes × worker_connections 直接当可服务客户端数。非 Windows 初始化会检查文件描述符资源限制，超出时记录警告，不由本项自动提高限制。
OpenResty privileged agent 的连接池使用独立 privileged_agent_connections 字段，而非本项；本站未核实目标环境资源和实际并发容量。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁对照普通 worker 数组分配、监听/客户端/上游取槽、回收和归还：reuseport_close_unused_fds 直接改变新增监听消费的非本 worker 分支，先 close、失败 EMERG、置 fd=-1 再 continue，因此标记已核对补丁影响；连接数组数量与旧配置事实不变。上游仅核53–64共享取槽，不展开受 socket_cloexec 修改的完整 socket/flags 路径；agent 使用独立连接数。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 固定源码的 ngx_event_core_module 列入基础事件模块，注册无独立编译 guard；初始化仍需可用事件后端，实际二进制与资源限制未核实。

<directive name="worker_connections">
<syntax><value>number</value></syntax>
<default>512</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that
can be opened by a worker process.
</para>

<para>
It should be kept in mind that this number includes all connections
(e.g. connections with proxied servers, among others),
not only connections with clients.
Another consideration is that the actual number of simultaneous
connections cannot exceed the current limit on
the maximum number of open files, which can be changed by
<link id="worker_rlimit_nofile"/>.
</para>

defaults.text: events 是显式事件配置块，不存在自动补出的默认 events 块或标量默认值；缺少该块时，事件模块初始化报 no "events" section in configuration。块内 worker_connections 等有各自默认值，不能代替块头默认。

inheritance.text: 只在 main 建立唯一事件配置上下文；回调拒绝重复块，创建各事件模块配置、解析并逐个 init_conf，不执行父子 events 的 merge。块内配置的初始化不等于 events 块继承。

limitations.text: 同一配置不能重复建立 events 块；它是块指令，没有分号结尾的普通参数列表。

entries.summary: 在 events 中控制普通 accept handler 一次通知是否继续尝试接收多个连接。非 kqueue 时，off 完成一次成功接收后结束循环，on 继续尝试；EAGAIN 会退出，其他错误是否继续取决于错误类型和可用数量。默认 off。

defaults.text: off（multi_accept = 0）。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块配置，无 server/location 层继承。

limitations.text: 参数只允许 on/off（不区分大小写），重复设置被拒绝；不能在 HTTP/stream 的 server 块内配置。
kqueue 使用事件提供的 available 数量并在循环中递减，不用本项覆盖该数量；Windows IOCP 走独立 acceptex handler。不能把 on 解释为所有平台都保证一次接收全部待连接。
accept4 返回 ENOSYS 时关闭 use_accept4 并继续，以 accept 回退；ECONNABORTED 在必要时递减 kqueue 的 available，仍非零则继续。不能把所有错误概括为立即退出。
有效 socket_cloexec 补丁为 accept4 增加 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在相应平台的 accept 后路径设置 FD_CLOEXEC；失败会关闭连接并返回。本站不根据此开关判断公平性或性能。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁逐项核所列 accept 消费与入口边界：socket_cloexec 直接给 accept4 增 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在 !inherited_nonblocking、非 IOCP、NGX_HAVE_FD_CLOEXEC 条件下加入 ngx_cloexec，失败清理后返回，保持 affected。available 和循环条件未变；ENOSYS 的 continue 仍检查循环尾，不能保证 off 非 kqueue 同次立即 fallback。未展开整个事件调度、UDP 或业务处理。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 基础事件模块中注册无独立编译 guard；实际效果依赖事件后端，kqueue/IOCP 不按普通非 kqueue accept 循环解释；目标环境未核实。

<directive name="multi_accept">
<syntax><literal>on</literal> | <literal>off</literal></syntax>
<default>off</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
If <literal>multi_accept</literal> is disabled, a worker process
will accept one new connection at a time.
Otherwise, a worker process
will accept all new connections at a time.
<note>
The directive is ignored if <link doc="events.xml" id="kqueue"/>
connection processing method is used, because it reports
the number of new connections waiting to be accepted.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

cd nginx-$ver || exit 1

entries.summary: 在 events 中设置每个普通 worker 的连接资源池大小，默认 512。配置值写入事件配置和 cycle->connection_n，用来分配连接对象及读写事件数组；不是只计客户端连接。

defaults.text: 512；由 DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS 初始化，而不是示例配置中的数值。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块中配置，不从 HTTP/stream 的 server/location 继承；未设置时使用事件配置默认值。

limitations.text: 只接受一个十进制数字参数；重复、非数字或超出 ngx_int_t 范围会被拒绝。配置初始化还要求至少容纳每个监听 socket 和一个 channel 连接；数值解析成功不代表配置可启动。
客户端、上游和监听连接均使用连接资源；不能将 worker_processes × worker_connections 直接当可服务客户端数。非 Windows 初始化会检查文件描述符资源限制，超出时记录警告，不由本项自动提高限制。
OpenResty privileged agent 的连接池使用独立 privileged_agent_connections 字段，而非本项；本站未核实目标环境资源和实际并发容量。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁对照普通 worker 数组分配、监听/客户端/上游取槽、回收和归还：reuseport_close_unused_fds 直接改变新增监听消费的非本 worker 分支，先 close、失败 EMERG、置 fd=-1 再 continue，因此标记已核对补丁影响；连接数组数量与旧配置事实不变。上游仅核53–64共享取槽，不展开受 socket_cloexec 修改的完整 socket/flags 路径；agent 使用独立连接数。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 固定源码的 ngx_event_core_module 列入基础事件模块，注册无独立编译 guard；初始化仍需可用事件后端，实际二进制与资源限制未核实。

<directive name="worker_connections">
<syntax><value>number</value></syntax>
<default>512</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that
can be opened by a worker process.
</para>

<para>
It should be kept in mind that this number includes all connections
(e.g. connections with proxied servers, among others),
not only connections with clients.
Another consideration is that the actual number of simultaneous
connections cannot exceed the current limit on
the maximum number of open files, which can be changed by
<link id="worker_rlimit_nofile"/>.

entries.summary: 在 events 中控制普通 accept handler 一次通知是否继续尝试接收多个连接。非 kqueue 时，off 完成一次成功接收后结束循环，on 继续尝试；EAGAIN 会退出，其他错误是否继续取决于错误类型和可用数量。默认 off。

defaults.text: off（multi_accept = 0）。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块配置，无 server/location 层继承。

limitations.text: 参数只允许 on/off（不区分大小写），重复设置被拒绝；不能在 HTTP/stream 的 server 块内配置。
kqueue 使用事件提供的 available 数量并在循环中递减，不用本项覆盖该数量；Windows IOCP 走独立 acceptex handler。不能把 on 解释为所有平台都保证一次接收全部待连接。
accept4 返回 ENOSYS 时关闭 use_accept4 并继续，以 accept 回退；ECONNABORTED 在必要时递减 kqueue 的 available，仍非零则继续。不能把所有错误概括为立即退出。
有效 socket_cloexec 补丁为 accept4 增加 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在相应平台的 accept 后路径设置 FD_CLOEXEC；失败会关闭连接并返回。本站不根据此开关判断公平性或性能。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁逐项核所列 accept 消费与入口边界：socket_cloexec 直接给 accept4 增 SOCK_CLOEXEC，并在 !inherited_nonblocking、非 IOCP、NGX_HAVE_FD_CLOEXEC 条件下加入 ngx_cloexec，失败清理后返回，保持 affected。available 和循环条件未变；ENOSYS 的 continue 仍检查循环尾，不能保证 off 非 kqueue 同次立即 fallback。未展开整个事件调度、UDP 或业务处理。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 基础事件模块中注册无独立编译 guard；实际效果依赖事件后端，kqueue/IOCP 不按普通非 kqueue accept 循环解释；目标环境未核实。

<directive name="multi_accept">
<syntax><literal>on</literal> | <literal>off</literal></syntax>
<default>off</default>
<context>events</context>

<para>
If <literal>multi_accept</literal> is disabled, a worker process
will accept one new connection at a time.
Otherwise, a worker process
will accept all new connections at a time.
<note>
The directive is ignored if <link doc="events.xml" id="kqueue"/>
connection processing method is used, because it reports
the number of new connections waiting to be accepted.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 在 events 中设置每个普通 worker 的连接资源池大小，默认 512。配置值写入事件配置和 cycle->connection_n，用来分配连接对象及读写事件数组；不是只计客户端连接。

defaults.text: 512；由 DEFAULT_CONNECTIONS 初始化，而不是示例配置中的数值。

inheritance.text: 仅在唯一 events 块中配置，不从 HTTP/stream 的 server/location 继承；未设置时使用事件配置默认值。

limitations.text: 只接受一个十进制数字参数；重复、非数字或超出 ngx_int_t 范围会被拒绝。配置初始化还要求至少容纳每个监听 socket 和一个 channel 连接；数值解析成功不代表配置可启动。
客户端、上游和监听连接均使用连接资源；不能将 worker_processes × worker_connections 直接当可服务客户端数。非 Windows 初始化会检查文件描述符资源限制，超出时记录警告，不由本项自动提高限制。
OpenResty privileged agent 的连接池使用独立 privileged_agent_connections 字段，而非本项；本站未核实目标环境资源和实际并发容量。

patch_status.note: 固定34项有效补丁对照普通 worker 数组分配、监听/客户端/上游取槽、回收和归还：reuseport_close_unused_fds 直接改变新增监听消费的非本 worker 分支，先 close、失败 EMERG、置 fd=-1 再 continue，因此标记已核对补丁影响；连接数组数量与旧配置事实不变。上游仅核53–64共享取槽，不展开受 socket_cloexec 修改的完整 socket/flags 路径；agent 使用独立连接数。旧回放为历史依据，本轮仅固定对象静态核查；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 固定源码的 ngx_event_core_module 列入基础事件模块，注册无独立编译 guard；初始化仍需可用事件后端，实际二进制与资源限制未核实。

<default/>
<context>stream</context>

<para>
Sets the configuration for a virtual server.
There is no clear separation between IP-based (based on the IP address)
and name-based (based on the
<link url="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication">TLS
Server Name Indication extension</link> (SNI, RFC 6066)) (1.25.5)
virtual servers.
Instead, the <link id="listen"/> directives describe all
addresses and ports that should accept connections for the server, and the
<link id="server_name"/> directive lists all server names.
</para>

</directive>

ver="$main_ver"
$root/util/get-tarball "https://openresty.org/download/nginx-$ver.tar.gz" -O nginx-$ver.tar.gz || exit 1
tar -xzf nginx-$ver.tar.gz || exit 1
cd nginx-$ver || exit 1

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中声明监听地址，支持端口、地址与端口、Unix-domain socket 等形式；默认使用 TCP，指定 udp 参数时使用 UDP。

defaults.text: 没有自动声明的监听地址；显式 listen 默认传输类型为 TCP（SOCK_STREAM）。

inheritance.text: 仅在 stream.server 中可用，不能从 stream 层继承一个 listen 声明。

limitations.text: 只允许在 stream 的 server 中配置；不能根据 listen 名称或端口值自动判定 HTTP/stream。
udp 与 backlog 等部分参数不能组合；部分监听参数受操作系统或编译条件限制。
端口号不决定应用层协议，也不会自动启用 TLS。

patch_status.note: 隔离副本应用发行脚本的 34 项有效补丁后，stream core 文件未变；监听声明、默认传输类型及所列参数校验不变。socket/reuseport 等底层代码另有补丁，不能将本条解释为监听运行时完全等同上游；未运行目标环境。 final25/B9：旧unaffected仅核stream listen声明/参数；新增共用event.c:804–828与accept.c:38–218、303–319消费直接绑定reuseport_close_unused_fds:17–38、socket_cloexec:82–113，因此verified_unaffected→verified_affected；普通默认接入不扩UDP/完整TLS。本项独立重核34补丁，不以stream core未改替代底层判断。

dependencies: 实际构建须启用 stream；udp 及其他可选参数还须满足源码中的平台/编译条件。

<syntax>

    [<literal>bind</literal>]
    [<literal>ipv6only</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>reuseport</literal>]
    [<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]]</syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the <value>address</value> and <value>port</value> for the socket
on which the server will accept connections.
It is possible to specify just the port.
The address can also be a hostname, for example:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
listen *:12345;
listen 12345;     # same as *:12345
listen localhost:12345;
</example>
IPv6 addresses are specified in square brackets:
<example>
listen [::1]:12345;
listen [::]:12345;
</example>
UNIX-domain sockets are specified with the “<literal>unix:</literal>”
prefix:
<example>
listen unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
</example>
</para>

<para id="listen_port_range">
Port ranges (1.15.10) are specified with the
first and last port separated by a hyphen:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1:12345-12399;
listen 12345-12399;
</example>
</para>

<para>
The <literal>default_server</literal> parameter, if present,
will cause the server to become the default server for the specified
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair (1.25.5).
If none of the directives have the <literal>default_server</literal>
parameter then the first server with the
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair will be
the default server for this pair.
</para>

<para>
The <literal>ssl</literal> parameter allows specifying that all
connections accepted on this port should work in SSL mode.
</para>

entries.summary: 配置Stream运行时域名解析器；例如代理目标需要动态解析时，用它提供的DNS服务器发起解析。

defaults.text: 没有配置DNS服务器；继承链为空时创建无nameserver的占位resolver，不自动读取系统DNS。

inheritance.text: 本层未配置时继承上层resolver对象；本层显式配置替代上层对象。

limitations.text: 固定OpenResty的local参数仅非Windows有效：on读取/etc/resolv.conf，path读取指定文件，off跳过该读取但不关闭显式DNS服务器；显式resolver配置最终没有任何DNS服务器会报错，仅配置local=off也属于此情况，local=on/path未读到服务器同样不能通过。status_zone是文档中的商业功能，不属于这里的开源实现。
有效发行补丁允许未编译IPv6支持时使用ipv6=off，但ipv6=on仍报错；不能把固定Nginx原始片段当作补丁后的完整行为。

patch_status.note: 共享ngx_resolver_create由resolver_conf_parsing增加非Windows local参数，并由safe_resolver_ipv6_option调整IPv6选项校验；Stream回调实际调用此共享入口，因此列为受影响，不能因Stream文件未变而标无影响。 在原 resolver_create 的 local/IPv6 选项补丁影响之外，新增核对实际消费的目标分类、地址缓存、共享 waiting、新查询、解析 timer 与 stream 回调；相关 resolver_conf_parsing/safe_resolver_ipv6_option hunk 不改这些所列消费片段。成功创建 peer 后仅跟踪到 connect 入口，不扩其 socket/DNS 协议。保持 verified_affected、原配置事实及全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

<default/>

<para>
Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers
into addresses, for example:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
</example>
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
with an optional port.
If port is not specified, the port 53 is used.
Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.
</para>

<para id="resolver_ipv6">
By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving.
If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired,
the <literal>ipv4=off</literal> (1.23.1) or
the <literal>ipv6=off</literal> parameter can be specified.
</para>

<para id="resolver_valid">
By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response.
The optional <literal>valid</literal> parameter allows overriding it:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
</example>
<note>
To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended
configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
</note>
</para>

<para id="resolver_status_zone">
The optional <literal>status_zone</literal> parameter (1.17.1)
enables
<link doc="../http/ngx_http_api_module.xml" id="resolvers_">collection</link>
of DNS server statistics of requests and responses
in the specified <value>zone</value>.
The parameter is available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</para>

<para>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="proxy_pass">
<syntax><value>address</value></syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the address of a proxied server.
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
and a port:
<example>
proxy_pass localhost:12345;
</example>
or as a UNIX-domain socket path:
<example>
proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
</example>
</para>

<para>
If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be
used in a round-robin fashion.
In addition, an address can be specified as a
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server group</link>.
</para>

<para>
The address can also be specified using variables (1.11.3):
<example>
proxy_pass $upstream;
</example>
In this case, the server name is searched among the described
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server groups</link>,
and, if not found, is determined using a
<link doc="ngx_stream_core_module.xml" id="resolver"/>.
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 设置 stream 代理建立上游连接的超时；配置值按毫秒解析，默认 60s。它不是整个业务会话的总时长上限。

inheritance.text: server 未设置时继承 stream 层的值；两层均未设置时使用 60s。

limitations.text: 与 proxy_timeout 的已连接读写超时分开；域名解析使用 resolver_timeout，不由本项统一覆盖。
OpenResty 的补丁将配置值复制到会话级代理上下文；stream Lua 的 balancer 超时接口可以覆盖该会话的值，不能仅凭 nginx.conf 推断实际超时。

patch_status.note: 已应用并核对 OpenResty 的有效 stream_proxy_timeout_fields 补丁：连接（及相应 TLS 握手）定时器改读会话上下文的 connect_timeout，初值仍来自本配置。上游源码与补丁分别引用，不把上游文件行号冒充发行版修改后的行号；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖连接返回分支、连接事件清理及下一 peer 门槛，并核对主动 TLS 的直接 timer 消费。stream_proxy_timeout_fields 将 timer 改读会话 ctx->connect_timeout，Lua 正数覆盖限本会话；balancer_status_code 新增内部特殊返回码结束，socket_cloexec 条件性修改 socket 创建，未改所列等待/重试判定。保持 verified_affected 和全部旧证据；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；Lua 动态覆盖还须有 stream Lua 模块及 balancer 调用。

entries.summary: 设置 stream 代理在客户端或上游连接上两次连续读写操作之间的超时，默认 10m。300s 不表示整个连接只能持续 300 秒；持续有读写活动的连接可以更久。

inheritance.text: server 未设置时继承 stream 层；两层均未设置时使用 10m。

limitations.text: 不替代建立上游连接使用的 proxy_connect_timeout，也不是 HTTP proxy_read_timeout。
UDP 超时还与 proxy_responses 等会话结束条件有关，不能照搬 TCP 的错误结束解释。
OpenResty 使用会话级 timeout 字段，stream Lua balancer 超时接口可以覆盖配置初值。

patch_status.note: 已核对 stream_proxy_timeout_fields 补丁：活动定时器由配置字段改读会话 ctx->timeout，初值复制自配置，Lua balancer 可覆盖。仅核对所列基本行为，不声称已完成整个事件/代理运行时链路的深度验证；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖双向转发 timer、lazy 更新、delayed 恢复、TCP/UDP 不同结束条件及主动 TLS 前 PROXY header 发送等待。stream_proxy_timeout_fields 将这些 timeout 消费改读会话 ctx->timeout，Lua 可覆盖正数值；普通活动超时与 PROXY 等待到期的下一 peer 出口分别解释。保持 verified_affected 及全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；UDP 与 Lua balancer 覆盖还取决于相应配置和模块。

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中定义可赋值变量及其值表达式。运行时在 preaccess 阶段按声明顺序求值并赋值；值可以包含文本与变量。

defaults.text: 没有自动创建的 set 赋值。

inheritance.text: 仅在 stream.server 可配置；该模块没有 server 配置合并回调。

limitations.text: 变量名必须以 $ 开头；仅能放在 stream.server，不能把 HTTP rewrite 模块的 set 规则套用到本项。
本站保留变量和表达式原文，不求值、不解析域名；设置一个域名字符串不会自动完成 proxy_pass 的运行时 DNS 配置。

patch_status.note: 应用发行版 34 项有效补丁后 stream set 文件逐字节未变；所列赋值配置入口及 preaccess handler 不受这些补丁直接修改。不据此判断其他模块使用变量时的完整行为；未运行。 新增 stream complex-value、indexed/flushed getter 与 PREACCESS phase engine/checker 片段也未被34项固定补丁直接修改；保持 verified_unaffected，不将 stream proxy 或 shared TLS 的补丁影响归入此赋值范围。

dependencies: 须启用 stream，且构建时不能使用 --without-stream_set_module 禁用此模块。

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中指定 TCP/UDP 数据转发的上游地址或 upstream 组，也可使用变量表达式。它不是 HTTP URL 转发，不包含 HTTP 路径重写语义。

defaults.text: 不会自动声明上游代理地址。

inheritance.text: 仅可在 stream.server 中配置，不能从 stream 层继承 proxy_pass 指令。

limitations.text: 变量地址求值后先匹配已声明的 upstream 组；若仍是需要 DNS 解析的域名，须有可用 resolver。IP 地址或匹配的 upstream 组不应一概被要求运行时 DNS。
地址中的 :443 只是端口，不会自动启用到上游的 TLS；stream proxy_ssl 默认 off，代理已经由客户端产生的 TLS 字节流与由代理主动建立 TLS 是两种行为。
同一 server 内重复设置会由配置入口拒绝；本站不检查参数、DNS可达性、上游协议或变更安全。

patch_status.note: 有效补丁修改代理 handler 的会话超时上下文、连接处理的 balancer 特殊返回码，并导出重试次数查询；proxy_pass 配置回调、变量寻址及 TLS 开关的所列代码片段未变。来源分别给出上游和补丁，不以未修改配置回调推断整个代理运行时未受影响；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖目标分类、解析回调与连接消费：stream_proxy_timeout_fields 改读会话超时；balancer_status_code 增加内部特殊状态直接结束；socket_cloexec 条件性修改上游 socket 创建。缓存/等待/解析超时及所列 peer 构造、下一 peer 门槛未被相关 hunk 改写；resolver_create 的 local/IPv6 选项补丁不替代这些消费证据。保持旧 affected 和全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；主动建立上游 TLS 还须启用 stream SSL 支持并配置 proxy_ssl。

<directive name="proxy_pass">
<syntax><value>address</value></syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the address of a proxied server.
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
and a port:
<example>
proxy_pass localhost:12345;
</example>
or as a UNIX-domain socket path:
<example>
proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
</example>
</para>

<para>
If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be
used in a round-robin fashion.
In addition, an address can be specified as a
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server group</link>.
</para>

<para>
The address can also be specified using variables (1.11.3):
<example>
proxy_pass $upstream;
</example>
In this case, the server name is searched among the described
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server groups</link>,
and, if not found, is determined using a
<link doc="ngx_stream_core_module.xml" id="resolver"/>.
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="resolver">
<syntax>
    <value>address</value> ...
    [<literal>valid</literal>=<value>time</value>]
    [<literal>ipv4</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>ipv6</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>status_zone</literal>=<value>zone</value>]</syntax>
<default/>
<context>stream</context>
<context>server</context>
<appeared-in>1.11.3</appeared-in>

<para>
Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers
into addresses, for example:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
</example>
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
with an optional port.
If port is not specified, the port 53 is used.
Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.
</para>

<para id="resolver_ipv6">
By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving.
If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired,
the <literal>ipv4=off</literal> (1.23.1) or
the <literal>ipv6=off</literal> parameter can be specified.
</para>

<para id="resolver_valid">
By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response.
The optional <literal>valid</literal> parameter allows overriding it:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
</example>
<note>
To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended
configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
</note>
</para>

<para id="resolver_status_zone">
The optional <literal>status_zone</literal> parameter (1.17.1)
enables
<link doc="../http/ngx_http_api_module.xml" id="resolvers_">collection</link>
of DNS server statistics of requests and responses
in the specified <value>zone</value>.
The parameter is available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</para>

<para>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="resolver_timeout">
<syntax><value>time</value></syntax>
<default>30s</default>
<context>stream</context>
<context>server</context>
<appeared-in>1.11.3</appeared-in>

<para>
Sets a timeout for name resolution, for example:
<example>
resolver_timeout 5s;
</example>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

entries.summary: 建立 HTTP 配置块，初始化各 HTTP 模块的配置，并组织虚拟服务器、location 及请求处理阶段；它本身不是监听地址指令。

defaults.text: http 是显式启用 HTTP 配置上下文的块指令，没有标量默认值或自动创建的 http 块；回调创建的空 srv_conf/loc_conf 仅作为 server 配置合并的父对象，不是默认 server 或 location。

inheritance.text: 该块只在主配置层声明，不存在同名块的 server/location 层继承。

limitations.text: 仅允许在主配置层出现；重复 http 块会报错。

entries.summary: 仅在 http 中绑定统计共享内存区并启用模块主统计开关；无参使用源码中的默认名称和大小，显式参数必须为 shared:name:size。

defaults.text: 未配置不建立本共享区，模块主统计开关默认关闭；无参配置使用 ngx_http_vhost_traffic_status 和 0xfffff。

inheritance.text: 仅在 http 主配置中注册，没有 server/location 的本指令继承层级。

limitations.text: 无参名称为 ngx_http_vhost_traffic_status，大小为 0xfffff（1048575 字节），不是精确 1 MiB；README 的 shared:vhost_traffic_status:1m 与源码默认名称及大小不同。
显式大小小于 8 个内存页会被拒绝；同共享区已绑定 data 时返回配置错误。
源码存在共享区不证明现场已编入或加载 VTS，也不证明实际共享内存资源充足。

patch_status.note: 本项仅研究独立上游 commit 快照，不属于本站发行补丁处理范围；现场补丁、安装及兼容性未知。 本轮另核VTS统计/展示所列运行消费与Nginx日志阶段、内容回调入口；34项发行补丁未直接改动所引新增入口片段，不代表公共输出、错误页或现场扩展兼容性全部通过。

dependencies: 需要额外编入或加载本扩展模块；固定 config 设置 NGX_STAT_STUB，使用 Nginx HTTP、共享内存及通用配置接口。本站未核实现场二进制、模块版本、加载状态或与发行基线的运行兼容性。

#define NGX_HTTP_VHOST_TRAFFIC_STATUS_DEFAULT_SHM_SIZE     0xfffff

### vhost_traffic_status_zone

| -   | - |
| --- | --- |
| **Syntax**  | **vhost_traffic_status_zone** [shared:*name:size*] |
| **Default** | shared:vhost_traffic_status:1m |
| **Context** | http |

`Description:` Sets parameters for a shared memory zone that will keep states for various keys.
The cache is shared between all worker processes.
In most cases, the shared memory size used by nginx-module-vts does not increase much.
The shared memory size is increased pretty when using `vhost_traffic_status_filter_by_set_key`
directive but if filter's keys are fixed(*eg. the total number of the country code is about 240*)
it does not continuously increase.

If you use `vhost_traffic_status_filter_by_set_key` directive, set it as follows:

* Set to more than 32M shared memory size by default.
(`vhost_traffic_status_zone shared:vhost_traffic_status:32m`)
* If the message(*`"ngx_slab_alloc() failed: no memory in vhost_traffic_status_zone"`*)
printed in error_log, increase to more than (usedSize * 2).

### vhost_traffic_status_zone

| -   | - |
| --- | --- |
| **Syntax**  | **vhost_traffic_status_zone** [shared:*name:size*] |
| **Default** | shared:vhost_traffic_status:1m |
| **Context** | http |

`Description:` Sets parameters for a shared memory zone that will keep states for various keys.
The cache is shared between all worker processes.
In most cases, the shared memory size used by nginx-module-vts does not increase much.
The shared memory size is increased pretty when using `vhost_traffic_status_filter_by_set_key`
directive but if filter's keys are fixed(*eg. the total number of the country code is about 240*)
it does not continuously increase.

If you use `vhost_traffic_status_filter_by_set_key` directive, set it as follows:

* Set to more than 32M shared memory size by default.
(`vhost_traffic_status_zone shared:vhost_traffic_status:32m`)
* If the message(*`"ngx_slab_alloc() failed: no memory in vhost_traffic_status_zone"`*)
printed in error_log, increase to more than (usedSize * 2).

* The name of shared memory specified in the configuration.(default: `vhost_traffic_status`)
  * maxSize
    * The limit on the maximum size of the shared memory specified in the configuration.
  * usedSize
    * The current size of the shared memory.
  * usedNode
    * The current number of node using in shared memory. It can get an approximate size for one node with the following formula: (*usedSize* / *usedNode*)
  * freeSize
    * The room the shared memory has left for more nodes. *usedSize* above is the sum of the sizes of the nodes, which is not what the zone has spent, because the slab allocator hands out a whole page or a whole slot for each of them. A zone therefore stops accepting nodes while *usedSize* still reads below *maxSize*, and this is the value that says so. A node is larger than half a page, so where a page is 4k this is the room for more of them; where the page is larger it is a lower bound, since a partly used page can still hold one.
* serverZones
  * requestCounter

First of all, the directive `vhost_traffic_status_zone` is required,
and then if the directive `vhost_traffic_status_display` is set, can be access to as follows:

* /status/format/json
  * If you request `/status/format/json`, will respond with a JSON document containing the current activity data for using in live dashboards and third-party monitoring tools.
* /status/format/html
  * If you request `/status/format/html`, will respond with the built-in live dashboard in HTML that requests internally to `/status/format/json`.
* /status/format/jsonp
  * If you request `/status/format/jsonp`, will respond with a JSONP callback function containing the current activity data for using in live dashboards and third-party monitoring tools. 
* /status/format/prometheus
  * If you request `/status/format/prometheus`, will respond with a [prometheus](https://prometheus.io) document containing the current activity data.

entries.summary: 在 HTTP 配置中建立一个虚拟服务器，保存其独立的 server/location 配置；请求最终由监听地址与服务器名称等条件选择该配置。

defaults.text: 这是显式建立 HTTP 虚拟服务器的块指令，没有可填入的标量默认值，也不会自动生成一个 server 块；http 层的空 srv_conf/loc_conf 是合并父配置，不是默认虚拟服务器。显式 server 未写 listen 时的隐式监听属于 listen 的默认规则。

inheritance.text: server 块本身不从其他 server 复制；每个显式块新建各 HTTP 模块的 srv_conf/loc_conf，并共用 http 的 main_conf。解析后，各模块分别将 http 层父 srv_conf/loc_conf 合并到这个 server，再合并其 location；具体字段按各模块 merge 回调决定，不意味着所有指令一律继承。

limitations.text: 这是 ngx_http_core_module 的 HTTP server，不是 stream 模块同名块；不能把配置存在视为端口已部署开放。

patch_status.note: 实际回放本发行版34项 Nginx 补丁并核对47个最终文件摘要后，所引注册、模块归属、配置回调及实现段保持原文；结论仅覆盖本条所列事实，不表示整个 HTTP 请求链没有补丁影响。 final25/B8新增默认请求上下文、名称/SNI回调配置选择，34补丁不直接改这些选定分支；未纳shared TLS握手yield、logger内部、error_pages合并，原局部unaffected保持。

<syntax block="yes"/>

<context>http</context>

<para>
Sets configuration for a virtual server.
There is no clear separation between IP-based (based on the IP address)
and name-based (based on the <header>Host</header> request header field)
virtual servers.
Instead, the <link id="listen"/> directives describe all
addresses and ports that should accept connections for the server, and the
<link id="server_name"/> directive lists all server names.
Example configurations are provided in the
“<link doc="request_processing.xml"/>” document.
</para>

</directive>

In this configuration nginx tests only the request’s header field
Host
to determine which server the request should be routed to. If its value does not match any server name, or the request does not contain this header field at all, then nginx will route the request to the default server for this port. In the configuration above, the default server is the first one—which is nginx’s standard default behaviour. It can also be set explicitly which server should be default, with the default_server parameter in the directive: server { listen 80 default_server; server_name example.net www.example.net; ... } The default_server parameter has been available since version 0.8.21. In earlier versions the default parameter should be used instead. Note that the default server is a property of the listen port and not of the server name. More about this later.

entries.summary: 为 HTTP 虚拟服务器登记监听地址、端口和协议/套接字选项，并将该地址关联到接入连接的 HTTP 处理入口。

defaults.text: 显式 server 未写任何 listen 时补建 IPv4 wildcard（0.0.0.0）TCP 监听：非 Windows 在配置解析进程 getuid()==0 时用 80，否则用 8000；Windows 分支固定 80。这不是按 worker 的 user 身份选端口。显式 listen 仅给 IP 地址而省略端口时则默认 80，不使用上述权限分支。默认监听选项使用 NGX_LISTEN_BACKLOG（随平台定义），rcvbuf/sndbuf 为 -1（不指定覆盖值），支持相关能力时 setfib/fastopen 为 -1；显式监听在有 IPv6 支持时 ipv6only 默认为 1。未指定 default_server 时，新地址初始以第一个登记的 server 为默认；server_name 不决定该默认归属。

inheritance.text: listen 只在 HTTP server 中登记，不从 http、其他 server 或 location 继承监听地址；每个 server 都有自己的显式 listen 标记，未设置时走本 server 的补建分支。相同地址/端口的 server 会进入同一监听分组，参数和 default_server 在地址级合并或检查重复；共享监听不是父子配置继承。

limitations.text: 参数包括 default_server、bind、backlog=number、rcvbuf=size、sndbuf=size、ssl、http2、quic、proxy_protocol 及平台相关套接字参数；listen ... http2 在本版本已弃用。ssl/http2/quic 及若干套接字选项受编译/平台条件约束，quic 与部分 TCP 选项不能组合。

patch_status.note: 实际回放本发行版34项 Nginx 补丁并核对47个最终文件摘要后，所引注册、模块归属、配置回调及实现段保持原文；结论仅覆盖本条所列事实，不表示整个 HTTP 请求链没有补丁影响。 final25/B8：旧unaffected只核listen配置；新增worker/accept消费绑定nginx event.c:804–828、accept.c:38–218、303–319，reuseport_close_unused_fds:17–38新增关闭/置-1，socket_cloexec:82–113新增accept4 CLOEXEC及受外层guard控制的cloexec失败清理；故verified_unaffected→verified_affected。本项不扩完整事件系统、TLS或所有socket路径。

<directive name="listen">
<syntax>
    <value>address</value>[:<value>port</value>]
    [<literal>default_server</literal>]
    [<literal>ssl</literal>]
    [<literal>http2</literal> |
     <literal>quic</literal>]

    [<literal>deferred</literal>]
    [<literal>bind</literal>]

    [<literal>reuseport</literal>]
    [<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]]</syntax>
<syntax>
    <value>port</value>
    [<literal>default_server</literal>]
    [<literal>ssl</literal>]
    [<literal>http2</literal> |
     <literal>quic</literal>]
    [<literal>proxy_protocol</literal>]
    [<literal>setfib</literal>=<value>number</value>]
    [<literal>fastopen</literal>=<value>number</value>]
    [<literal>backlog</literal>=<value>number</value>]
    [<literal>rcvbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>]
    [<literal>sndbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>]
    [<literal>accept_filter</literal>=<value>filter</value>]
    [<literal>deferred</literal>]
    [<literal>bind</literal>]
    [<literal>ipv6only</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>reuseport</literal>]
    [<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]]</syntax>
<syntax>
    <literal>unix:</literal><value>path</value>
    [<literal>default_server</literal>]
    [<literal>ssl</literal>]
    [<literal>http2</literal> |
     <literal>quic</literal>]
    [<literal>proxy_protocol</literal>]
    [<literal>backlog</literal>=<value>number</value>]
    [<literal>rcvbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>]
    [<literal>sndbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>]
    [<literal>accept_filter</literal>=<value>filter</value>]
    [<literal>deferred</literal>]
    [<literal>bind</literal>]
    [<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]]</syntax>
<default>*:80 | *:8000</default>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the <value>address</value> and <value>port</value> for IP,
or the <value>path</value> for a UNIX-domain socket on which
the server will accept requests.
Both <value>address</value> and <value>port</value>,
or only <value>address</value> or only <value>port</value> can be specified.
An <value>address</value> may also be a hostname, for example:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1:8000;
listen 127.0.0.1;
listen 8000;
listen *:8000;
listen localhost:8000;
</example>
IPv6 addresses (0.7.36) are specified in square brackets:
<example>
listen [::]:8000;
listen [::1];
</example>
UNIX-domain sockets (0.8.21) are specified with the “<literal>unix:</literal>”
prefix:
<example>
listen unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
</example>
</para>

<para>
If only <value>address</value> is given, the port 80 is used.
</para>

<para>
If the directive is not present then either <literal>*:80</literal> is used
if nginx runs with the superuser privileges, or <literal>*:8000</literal>
otherwise.
</para>

<para>
The <literal>default_server</literal> parameter, if present,
will cause the server to become the default server for the specified
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair.
If none of the directives have the <literal>default_server</literal>
parameter then the first server with the
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair will be
the default server for this pair.
<note>
In versions prior to 0.8.21 this parameter is named simply
<literal>default</literal>.
</note>
</para>

<para>
The <literal>ssl</literal> parameter (0.7.14) allows specifying that all
connections accepted on this port should work in SSL mode.
This allows for a more compact <link doc="configuring_https_servers.xml"
id="single_http_https_server">configuration</link> for the server that
handles both HTTP and HTTPS requests.
</para>

<para>
The <literal>http2</literal> parameter (1.9.5) configures the port to accept
<link doc="ngx_http_v2_module.xml">HTTP/2</link> connections.
Normally, for this to work the <literal>ssl</literal> parameter should be
specified as well, but nginx can also be configured to accept HTTP/2
connections without SSL.
<note>
The parameter is deprecated,
the <link doc="ngx_http_v2_module.xml" id="http2">http2</link> directive
should be used instead.
</note>
</para>

<para id="quic">
The <literal>quic</literal> parameter (1.25.0) configures the port to accept
<link doc="ngx_http_v3_module.xml">QUIC</link> connections.
</para>

<para>
The <literal>proxy_protocol</literal> parameter (1.5.12)
allows specifying that all connections accepted on this port should use the
<link url="http://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt">PROXY
protocol</link>.
<note>
The PROXY protocol version 2 is supported since version 1.13.11.
</note>
</para>

<para>
The <literal>listen</literal> directive
can have several additional parameters specific to socket-related system calls.
These parameters can be specified in any
<literal>listen</literal> directive, but only once for a given
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair.
<note>
In versions prior to 0.8.21, they could only be
specified in the <literal>listen</literal> directive together with the
<literal>default</literal> parameter.
</note>
<list type="tag">

<tag-name>
<literal>setfib</literal>=<value>number</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
this parameter (0.8.44) sets the associated routing table, FIB
(the <c-def>SO_SETFIB</c-def> option) for the listening socket.
This currently works only on FreeBSD.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>fastopen</literal>=<value>number</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
enables
“<link url="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TCP_Fast_Open">TCP Fast Open</link>”
for the listening socket (1.5.8) and
<link url="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-5.1">limits</link>
the maximum length for the queue of connections that have not yet completed
the three-way handshake.
<note>
Do not enable this feature unless the server can handle
receiving the
<link url="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7413#section-6.1">
same SYN packet with data</link> more than once.
</note>
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>backlog</literal>=<value>number</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
sets the <literal>backlog</literal> parameter in the
<c-func>listen</c-func> call that limits
the maximum length for the queue of pending connections.
By default,
<literal>backlog</literal> is set to -1 on FreeBSD, DragonFly BSD, and macOS,
and to 511 on other platforms.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>rcvbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
sets the receive buffer size
(the <c-def>SO_RCVBUF</c-def> option) for the listening socket.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>sndbuf</literal>=<value>size</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
sets the send buffer size
(the <c-def>SO_SNDBUF</c-def> option) for the listening socket.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>accept_filter</literal>=<value>filter</value>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
sets the name of accept filter
(the <c-def>SO_ACCEPTFILTER</c-def> option) for the listening socket
that filters incoming connections before passing them to
<c-func>accept</c-func>.
This works only on FreeBSD and NetBSD 5.0+.
Possible values are
<link url="http://man.freebsd.org/accf_data">dataready</link>
and
<link url="http://man.freebsd.org/accf_http">httpready</link>.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>deferred</literal>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
instructs to use a deferred <c-func>accept</c-func>
(the <c-def>TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT</c-def> socket option) on Linux.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>bind</literal>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
instructs to make a separate <c-func>bind</c-func> call for a given
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair.
This is useful because if there are several <literal>listen</literal>
directives with the same port but different addresses, and one of the
<literal>listen</literal> directives listens on all addresses
for the given port (<literal>*:</literal><value>port</value>), nginx
will <c-func>bind</c-func> only to <literal>*:</literal><value>port</value>.
It should be noted that the <c-func>getsockname</c-func> system call will be
made in this case to determine the address that accepted the connection.
If the <literal>setfib</literal>,
<literal>fastopen</literal>,
<literal>backlog</literal>, <literal>rcvbuf</literal>,
<literal>sndbuf</literal>, <literal>accept_filter</literal>,
<literal>deferred</literal>, <literal>ipv6only</literal>,
<literal>reuseport</literal>,
or <literal>so_keepalive</literal> parameters
are used then for a given
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair
a separate <c-func>bind</c-func> call will always be made.
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>ipv6only</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
this parameter (0.7.42) determines
(via the <c-def>IPV6_V6ONLY</c-def> socket option)
whether an IPv6 socket listening on a wildcard address <literal>[::]</literal>
will accept only IPv6 connections or both IPv6 and IPv4 connections.
This parameter is turned on by default.
It can only be set once on start.
<note>
Prior to version 1.3.4,
if this parameter was omitted then the operating system’s settings were
in effect for the socket.
</note>
</tag-desc>

<tag-name id="reuseport">
<literal>reuseport</literal>
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
this parameter (1.9.1) instructs to create an individual listening socket
for each worker process
(using the
<c-def>SO_REUSEPORT</c-def> socket option on Linux 3.9+ and DragonFly BSD,
or <c-def>SO_REUSEPORT_LB</c-def> on FreeBSD 12+), allowing a kernel
to distribute incoming connections between worker processes.
This currently works only on Linux 3.9+, DragonFly BSD,
and FreeBSD 12+ (1.15.1).
<note>
Inappropriate use of this option may have its security
<link url="http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/socket.7.html">implications</link>.
</note>
</tag-desc>

<tag-name>
<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]
</tag-name>
<tag-desc>
this parameter (1.1.11) configures the “TCP keepalive” behavior
for the listening socket.
If this parameter is omitted then the operating system’s settings will be
in effect for the socket.
If it is set to the value “<literal>on</literal>”, the
<c-def>SO_KEEPALIVE</c-def> option is turned on for the socket.
If it is set to the value “<literal>off</literal>”, the
<c-def>SO_KEEPALIVE</c-def> option is turned off for the socket.
Some operating systems support setting of TCP keepalive parameters on
a per-socket basis using the <c-def>TCP_KEEPIDLE</c-def>,
<c-def>TCP_KEEPINTVL</c-def>, and <c-def>TCP_KEEPCNT</c-def> socket options.
On such systems (currently, Linux 2.4+, NetBSD 5+, and
FreeBSD 9.0-STABLE), they can be configured
using the <value>keepidle</value>, <value>keepintvl</value>, and
<value>keepcnt</value> parameters.
One or two parameters may be omitted, in which case the system default setting
for the corresponding socket option will be in effect.
For example,
<example>so_keepalive=30m::10</example>
will set the idle timeout (<c-def>TCP_KEEPIDLE</c-def>) to 30 minutes,
leave the probe interval (<c-def>TCP_KEEPINTVL</c-def>) at its system default,
and set the probes count (<c-def>TCP_KEEPCNT</c-def>) to 10 probes.
</tag-desc>

</list>
</para>

<para>
Example:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1 default_server accept_filter=dataready backlog=1024;
</example>
</para>

entries.summary: 为 URI 匹配建立请求配置：支持精确匹配、前缀匹配、正则匹配及供内部跳转使用的命名 location。

defaults.text: 这是带匹配条件的显式配置块，没有默认 URI 或自动声明的 location /；server 创建的 loc_conf 是未匹配显式 location 时可用的配置，不等于生成一个 location 块。每个显式 location 的匹配条件由其参数建立。

inheritance.text: 显式 location 共用父级 main_conf/srv_conf，但新建每个 HTTP 模块的 loc_conf。合并从 server 的 loc_conf 开始，递归将直接父 location 的配置交给模块 merge_loc_conf；匹配条件及块本身不作为标量继承，各指令是否继承或替换由模块回调决定。

limitations.text: 命名 location 只能放在 server 层；正则需要 PCRE 支持，不能从注册存在推断实际构建已具备它。

patch_status.note: 实际回放本发行版34项 Nginx 补丁并核对47个最终文件摘要后，所引注册、模块归属、配置回调及实现段保持原文；结论仅覆盖本条所列事实，不表示整个 HTTP 请求链没有补丁影响。 final25/B8新增实际静态/正则/命名查找及重查，34补丁无直接修改所选查找/guard/跳转分支。no_error_pages在配置合并/指令入口，不改变本步骤内部跳转实现；未概括完整错误页策略或所有模块路径，原局部unaffected保持。

<directive name="location">
<syntax block="yes">[
    <literal>=</literal> |
    <literal>~</literal> |
    <literal>~*</literal> |
    <literal>^~</literal>
    ] <value>uri</value></syntax>
<syntax block="yes"><literal>@</literal><value>name</value></syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>
<context>location</context>

<para>
Sets configuration depending on a request URI.
</para>

<para>
The matching is performed against a normalized URI,
after decoding the text encoded in the “<literal>%XX</literal>” form,
resolving references to relative path components “<literal>.</literal>”
and “<literal>..</literal>”, and possible
<link id="merge_slashes">compression</link> of two or more
adjacent slashes into a single slash.
</para>

<para>
A location can either be defined by a prefix string, or by a regular expression.
Regular expressions are specified with the preceding
“<literal>~*</literal>” modifier (for case-insensitive matching), or the
“<literal>~</literal>” modifier (for case-sensitive matching).
To find location matching a given request, nginx first checks
locations defined using the prefix strings (prefix locations).
Among them, the location with the longest matching
prefix is selected and remembered.
Then regular expressions are checked, in the order of their appearance
in the configuration file.
The search of regular expressions terminates on the first match,
and the corresponding configuration is used.
If no match with a regular expression is found then the
configuration of the prefix location remembered earlier is used.
</para>

<para>
<literal>location</literal> blocks can be nested, with some exceptions
mentioned below.
</para>

<para>
For case-insensitive operating systems such as macOS and Cygwin,
matching with prefix strings ignores a case (0.7.7).
However, comparison is limited to one-byte locales.
</para>

<para>
Regular expressions can contain captures (0.7.40) that can later
be used in other directives.
</para>

<para>
If the longest matching prefix location has the “<literal>^~</literal>” modifier
then regular expressions are not checked.
</para>

<para>
Also, using the “<literal>=</literal>” modifier it is possible to define
an exact match of URI and location.
If an exact match is found, the search terminates.
For example, if a “<literal>/</literal>” request happens frequently,
defining “<literal>location = /</literal>” will speed up the processing
of these requests, as search terminates right after the first
comparison.
Such a location cannot obviously contain nested locations.
</para>

<para>
<note>
In versions from 0.7.1 to 0.8.41, if a request matched the prefix
location without the “<literal>=</literal>” and “<literal>^~</literal>”
modifiers, the search also terminated and regular expressions were
not checked.
</note>
</para>

<para>
Let’s illustrate the above by an example:
<example>
location = / {
    [ configuration A ]
}

location / {
    [ configuration B ]
}

location /documents/ {
    [ configuration C ]
}

location ^~ /images/ {
    [ configuration D ]
}

location ~* \.(gif|jpg|jpeg)$ {
    [ configuration E ]
}
</example>
The “<literal>/</literal>” request will match configuration A,
the “<literal>/index.html</literal>” request will match configuration B,
the “<literal>/documents/document.html</literal>” request will match
configuration C,
the “<literal>/images/1.gif</literal>” request will match configuration D, and
the “<literal>/documents/1.jpg</literal>” request will match configuration E.
</para>

<para id="location_named">
The “<literal>@</literal>” prefix defines a named location.
Such a location is not used for a regular request processing, but instead
used for request redirection.
They cannot be nested, and cannot contain nested locations.
</para>

<para>
If a location is defined by a prefix string that ends with the slash character,
and requests are processed by one of
<link doc="ngx_http_proxy_module.xml" id="proxy_pass"/>,
<link doc="ngx_http_fastcgi_module.xml" id="fastcgi_pass"/>,
<link doc="ngx_http_uwsgi_module.xml" id="uwsgi_pass"/>,
<link doc="ngx_http_scgi_module.xml" id="scgi_pass"/>,
<link doc="ngx_http_memcached_module.xml" id="memcached_pass"/>, or
<link doc="ngx_http_grpc_module.xml" id="grpc_pass"/>,
then the special processing is performed.
In response to a request with URI equal to this string,
but without the trailing slash,
a permanent redirect with the code 301 will be returned to the requested URI
with the slash appended.
If this is not desired, an exact match of the URI and location could be
defined like this:
<example>
location /user/ {
    proxy_pass http://user.example.com;
}

location = /user {
    proxy_pass http://login.example.com;
}
</example>
</para>

entries.summary: 在当前 server/location 的 HTTP 核心配置上安装 VTS content handler，提供统计展示以及 URI 对应的控制处理。

defaults.text: 默认不由本指令安装展示入口；它不是 on/off 配置字段，只有显式调用回调才将当前 HTTP 核心 location 的 handler 设为 VTS 展示函数。VTS zone 启用、统计收集或输出格式的默认值，不等于自动开放展示地址。此结论限所列扩展快照及 Nginx 1.27.1 核心配置模型，不表示现场兼容性已验证。

inheritance.text: 按所列 Nginx 1.27.1 核心源码，独立子 location 新建的 handler 初始为空，核心 merge_loc_conf 不复制父 handler；VTS 自身合并函数也不安装该 handler。因此不能因父 server/location 配置了 display 就认为每个独立子 location 都继承展示入口。请求仍使用已绑定的同一 location 配置，与新建子 location 继承不是一回事；格式等 VTS 字段的合并规则不代表入口继承。现场模块组合及运行兼容性仍未核实。

limitations.text: 注册只允许 http.server/http.location；README 标注 http 与固定注册表冲突。
注册允许无参或一参，回调不读取参数；一参不会成为显示开关、路径或输出格式。
展示入口主 ctx 未启用返回 501，仅处理 GET/HEAD；控制路径包含 reset/delete，不能把整个入口描述为永远只读。

### vhost_traffic_status_display

| -   | - |

| **Syntax**  | **vhost_traffic_status_display** |
| **Default** | - |
| **Context** | http, server, location |

`Description:` Enables or disables the module display handler.

First of all, the directive `vhost_traffic_status_zone` is required,
and then if the directive `vhost_traffic_status_display` is set, can be access to as follows:

* /status/format/json
  * If you request `/status/format/json`, will respond with a JSON document containing the current activity data for using in live dashboards and third-party monitoring tools.
* /status/format/html
  * If you request `/status/format/html`, will respond with the built-in live dashboard in HTML that requests internally to `/status/format/json`.
* /status/format/jsonp
  * If you request `/status/format/jsonp`, will respond with a JSONP callback function containing the current activity data for using in live dashboards and third-party monitoring tools. 
* /status/format/prometheus
  * If you request `/status/format/prometheus`, will respond with a [prometheus](https://prometheus.io) document containing the current activity data.

defaults.text: stream 是显式建立流配置上下文的块指令，没有标量默认值，也不会自动生成 stream 块或默认 server。回调创建的空 srv_conf 是显式 server 的合并父配置，不是一个会话服务。

inheritance.text: 只在 main 声明唯一 stream 块，回调拒绝重复，创建模块 main_conf 和父 srv_conf。stream 块本身没有父子层合并；显式 server 逐个调用模块 merge_srv_conf 接收 stream 层父配置，具体继承规则属于块内指令。

limitations.text: 这是main层无参数配置块，同一配置上下文重复声明被拒绝；不是http中的块，也不单独提供会话内容处理。

<para>
Sets the configuration for a virtual server.
There is no clear separation between IP-based (based on the IP address)
and name-based (based on the
<link url="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server_Name_Indication">TLS
Server Name Indication extension</link> (SNI, RFC 6066)) (1.25.5)
virtual servers.
Instead, the <link id="listen"/> directives describe all
addresses and ports that should accept connections for the server, and the
<link id="server_name"/> directive lists all server names.
</para>

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中声明监听地址，支持端口、地址与端口、Unix-domain socket 等形式；默认使用 TCP，指定 udp 参数时使用 UDP。

defaults.text: 没有自动声明的监听地址；显式 listen 默认传输类型为 TCP（SOCK_STREAM）。

inheritance.text: 仅在 stream.server 中可用，不能从 stream 层继承一个 listen 声明。

limitations.text: 只允许在 stream 的 server 中配置；不能根据 listen 名称或端口值自动判定 HTTP/stream。
udp 与 backlog 等部分参数不能组合；部分监听参数受操作系统或编译条件限制。
端口号不决定应用层协议，也不会自动启用 TLS。

patch_status.note: 隔离副本应用发行脚本的 34 项有效补丁后，stream core 文件未变；监听声明、默认传输类型及所列参数校验不变。socket/reuseport 等底层代码另有补丁，不能将本条解释为监听运行时完全等同上游；未运行目标环境。 final25/B9：旧unaffected仅核stream listen声明/参数；新增共用event.c:804–828与accept.c:38–218、303–319消费直接绑定reuseport_close_unused_fds:17–38、socket_cloexec:82–113，因此verified_unaffected→verified_affected；普通默认接入不扩UDP/完整TLS。本项独立重核34补丁，不以stream core未改替代底层判断。

dependencies: 实际构建须启用 stream；udp 及其他可选参数还须满足源码中的平台/编译条件。

<syntax>

    [<literal>reuseport</literal>]
    [<literal>so_keepalive</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>|[<value>keepidle</value>]:[<value>keepintvl</value>]:[<value>keepcnt</value>]]</syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the <value>address</value> and <value>port</value> for the socket
on which the server will accept connections.
It is possible to specify just the port.
The address can also be a hostname, for example:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1:12345;
listen *:12345;
listen 12345;     # same as *:12345
listen localhost:12345;
</example>
IPv6 addresses are specified in square brackets:
<example>
listen [::1]:12345;
listen [::]:12345;
</example>
UNIX-domain sockets are specified with the “<literal>unix:</literal>”
prefix:
<example>
listen unix:/var/run/nginx.sock;
</example>
</para>

<para id="listen_port_range">
Port ranges (1.15.10) are specified with the
first and last port separated by a hyphen:
<example>
listen 127.0.0.1:12345-12399;
listen 12345-12399;
</example>
</para>

<para>
The <literal>default_server</literal> parameter, if present,
will cause the server to become the default server for the specified
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair (1.25.5).
If none of the directives have the <literal>default_server</literal>
parameter then the first server with the
<value>address</value>:<value>port</value> pair will be
the default server for this pair.
</para>

<para>
The <literal>ssl</literal> parameter allows specifying that all
connections accepted on this port should work in SSL mode.
</para>

entries.summary: 配置Stream运行时域名解析器；例如代理目标需要动态解析时，用它提供的DNS服务器发起解析。

defaults.text: 没有配置DNS服务器；继承链为空时创建无nameserver的占位resolver，不自动读取系统DNS。

inheritance.text: 本层未配置时继承上层resolver对象；本层显式配置替代上层对象。

limitations.text: 固定OpenResty的local参数仅非Windows有效：on读取/etc/resolv.conf，path读取指定文件，off跳过该读取但不关闭显式DNS服务器；显式resolver配置最终没有任何DNS服务器会报错，仅配置local=off也属于此情况，local=on/path未读到服务器同样不能通过。status_zone是文档中的商业功能，不属于这里的开源实现。
有效发行补丁允许未编译IPv6支持时使用ipv6=off，但ipv6=on仍报错；不能把固定Nginx原始片段当作补丁后的完整行为。

patch_status.note: 共享ngx_resolver_create由resolver_conf_parsing增加非Windows local参数，并由safe_resolver_ipv6_option调整IPv6选项校验；Stream回调实际调用此共享入口，因此列为受影响，不能因Stream文件未变而标无影响。 在原 resolver_create 的 local/IPv6 选项补丁影响之外，新增核对实际消费的目标分类、地址缓存、共享 waiting、新查询、解析 timer 与 stream 回调；相关 resolver_conf_parsing/safe_resolver_ipv6_option hunk 不改这些所列消费片段。成功创建 peer 后仅跟踪到 connect 入口，不扩其 socket/DNS 协议。保持 verified_affected、原配置事实及全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

<default/>

<context>server</context>

<para>
Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers
into addresses, for example:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
</example>
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
with an optional port.
If port is not specified, the port 53 is used.
Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.
</para>

<para id="resolver_ipv6">
By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving.
If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired,
the <literal>ipv4=off</literal> (1.23.1) or
the <literal>ipv6=off</literal> parameter can be specified.
</para>

<para id="resolver_valid">
By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response.
The optional <literal>valid</literal> parameter allows overriding it:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
</example>
<note>
To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended
configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
</note>
</para>

<para id="resolver_status_zone">
The optional <literal>status_zone</literal> parameter (1.17.1)
enables
<link doc="../http/ngx_http_api_module.xml" id="resolvers_">collection</link>
of DNS server statistics of requests and responses
in the specified <value>zone</value>.
The parameter is available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</para>

<para>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="proxy_pass">
<syntax><value>address</value></syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the address of a proxied server.
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
and a port:
<example>
proxy_pass localhost:12345;
</example>
or as a UNIX-domain socket path:
<example>
proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
</example>
</para>

<para>
If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be
used in a round-robin fashion.
In addition, an address can be specified as a
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server group</link>.
</para>

<para>
The address can also be specified using variables (1.11.3):
<example>
proxy_pass $upstream;
</example>
In this case, the server name is searched among the described
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server groups</link>,
and, if not found, is determined using a
<link doc="ngx_stream_core_module.xml" id="resolver"/>.
</para>

entries.summary: 设置 stream 代理建立上游连接的超时；配置值按毫秒解析，默认 60s。它不是整个业务会话的总时长上限。

inheritance.text: server 未设置时继承 stream 层的值；两层均未设置时使用 60s。

limitations.text: 与 proxy_timeout 的已连接读写超时分开；域名解析使用 resolver_timeout，不由本项统一覆盖。
OpenResty 的补丁将配置值复制到会话级代理上下文；stream Lua 的 balancer 超时接口可以覆盖该会话的值，不能仅凭 nginx.conf 推断实际超时。

patch_status.note: 已应用并核对 OpenResty 的有效 stream_proxy_timeout_fields 补丁：连接（及相应 TLS 握手）定时器改读会话上下文的 connect_timeout，初值仍来自本配置。上游源码与补丁分别引用，不把上游文件行号冒充发行版修改后的行号；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖连接返回分支、连接事件清理及下一 peer 门槛，并核对主动 TLS 的直接 timer 消费。stream_proxy_timeout_fields 将 timer 改读会话 ctx->connect_timeout，Lua 正数覆盖限本会话；balancer_status_code 新增内部特殊返回码结束，socket_cloexec 条件性修改 socket 创建，未改所列等待/重试判定。保持 verified_affected 和全部旧证据；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；Lua 动态覆盖还须有 stream Lua 模块及 balancer 调用。

entries.summary: 设置 stream 代理在客户端或上游连接上两次连续读写操作之间的超时，默认 10m。300s 不表示整个连接只能持续 300 秒；持续有读写活动的连接可以更久。

inheritance.text: server 未设置时继承 stream 层；两层均未设置时使用 10m。

limitations.text: 不替代建立上游连接使用的 proxy_connect_timeout，也不是 HTTP proxy_read_timeout。
UDP 超时还与 proxy_responses 等会话结束条件有关，不能照搬 TCP 的错误结束解释。
OpenResty 使用会话级 timeout 字段，stream Lua balancer 超时接口可以覆盖配置初值。

patch_status.note: 已核对 stream_proxy_timeout_fields 补丁：活动定时器由配置字段改读会话 ctx->timeout，初值复制自配置，Lua balancer 可覆盖。仅核对所列基本行为，不声称已完成整个事件/代理运行时链路的深度验证；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖双向转发 timer、lazy 更新、delayed 恢复、TCP/UDP 不同结束条件及主动 TLS 前 PROXY header 发送等待。stream_proxy_timeout_fields 将这些 timeout 消费改读会话 ctx->timeout，Lua 可覆盖正数值；普通活动超时与 PROXY 等待到期的下一 peer 出口分别解释。保持 verified_affected 及全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；UDP 与 Lua balancer 覆盖还取决于相应配置和模块。

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中定义可赋值变量及其值表达式。运行时在 preaccess 阶段按声明顺序求值并赋值；值可以包含文本与变量。

defaults.text: 没有自动创建的 set 赋值。

inheritance.text: 仅在 stream.server 可配置；该模块没有 server 配置合并回调。

limitations.text: 变量名必须以 $ 开头；仅能放在 stream.server，不能把 HTTP rewrite 模块的 set 规则套用到本项。
本站保留变量和表达式原文，不求值、不解析域名；设置一个域名字符串不会自动完成 proxy_pass 的运行时 DNS 配置。

patch_status.note: 应用发行版 34 项有效补丁后 stream set 文件逐字节未变；所列赋值配置入口及 preaccess handler 不受这些补丁直接修改。不据此判断其他模块使用变量时的完整行为；未运行。 新增 stream complex-value、indexed/flushed getter 与 PREACCESS phase engine/checker 片段也未被34项固定补丁直接修改；保持 verified_unaffected，不将 stream proxy 或 shared TLS 的补丁影响归入此赋值范围。

dependencies: 须启用 stream，且构建时不能使用 --without-stream_set_module 禁用此模块。

entries.summary: 在 stream.server 中指定 TCP/UDP 数据转发的上游地址或 upstream 组，也可使用变量表达式。它不是 HTTP URL 转发，不包含 HTTP 路径重写语义。

defaults.text: 不会自动声明上游代理地址。

inheritance.text: 仅可在 stream.server 中配置，不能从 stream 层继承 proxy_pass 指令。

limitations.text: 变量地址求值后先匹配已声明的 upstream 组；若仍是需要 DNS 解析的域名，须有可用 resolver。IP 地址或匹配的 upstream 组不应一概被要求运行时 DNS。
地址中的 :443 只是端口，不会自动启用到上游的 TLS；stream proxy_ssl 默认 off，代理已经由客户端产生的 TLS 字节流与由代理主动建立 TLS 是两种行为。
同一 server 内重复设置会由配置入口拒绝；本站不检查参数、DNS可达性、上游协议或变更安全。

patch_status.note: 有效补丁修改代理 handler 的会话超时上下文、连接处理的 balancer 特殊返回码，并导出重试次数查询；proxy_pass 配置回调、变量寻址及 TLS 开关的所列代码片段未变。来源分别给出上游和补丁，不以未修改配置回调推断整个代理运行时未受影响；未编译或运行。 新增运行时核对覆盖目标分类、解析回调与连接消费：stream_proxy_timeout_fields 改读会话超时；balancer_status_code 增加内部特殊状态直接结束；socket_cloexec 条件性修改上游 socket 创建。缓存/等待/解析超时及所列 peer 构造、下一 peer 门槛未被相关 hunk 改写；resolver_create 的 local/IPv6 选项补丁不替代这些消费证据。保持旧 affected 和全部旧引用；未编译或运行。

dependencies: 实际环境须启用 stream 代理模块；主动建立上游 TLS 还须启用 stream SSL 支持并配置 proxy_ssl。

<directive name="proxy_pass">
<syntax><value>address</value></syntax>
<default/>
<context>server</context>

<para>
Sets the address of a proxied server.
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
and a port:
<example>
proxy_pass localhost:12345;
</example>
or as a UNIX-domain socket path:
<example>
proxy_pass unix:/tmp/stream.socket;
</example>
</para>

<para>
If a domain name resolves to several addresses, all of them will be
used in a round-robin fashion.
In addition, an address can be specified as a
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server group</link>.
</para>

<para>
The address can also be specified using variables (1.11.3):
<example>
proxy_pass $upstream;
</example>
In this case, the server name is searched among the described
<link doc="ngx_stream_upstream_module.xml">server groups</link>,
and, if not found, is determined using a
<link doc="ngx_stream_core_module.xml" id="resolver"/>.
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="resolver">
<syntax>
    <value>address</value> ...
    [<literal>valid</literal>=<value>time</value>]
    [<literal>ipv4</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>ipv6</literal>=<literal>on</literal>|<literal>off</literal>]
    [<literal>status_zone</literal>=<value>zone</value>]</syntax>
<default/>
<context>stream</context>
<context>server</context>
<appeared-in>1.11.3</appeared-in>

<para>
Configures name servers used to resolve names of upstream servers
into addresses, for example:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353;
</example>
The address can be specified as a domain name or IP address,
with an optional port.
If port is not specified, the port 53 is used.
Name servers are queried in a round-robin fashion.
</para>

<para id="resolver_ipv6">
By default, nginx will look up both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses while resolving.
If looking up of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses is not desired,
the <literal>ipv4=off</literal> (1.23.1) or
the <literal>ipv6=off</literal> parameter can be specified.
</para>

<para id="resolver_valid">
By default, nginx caches answers using the TTL value of a response.
The optional <literal>valid</literal> parameter allows overriding it:
<example>
resolver 127.0.0.1 [::1]:5353 valid=30s;
</example>
<note>
To prevent DNS spoofing, it is recommended
configuring DNS servers in a properly secured trusted local network.
</note>
</para>

<para id="resolver_status_zone">
The optional <literal>status_zone</literal> parameter (1.17.1)
enables
<link doc="../http/ngx_http_api_module.xml" id="resolvers_">collection</link>
of DNS server statistics of requests and responses
in the specified <value>zone</value>.
The parameter is available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</para>

<para>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>

<directive name="resolver_timeout">
<syntax><value>time</value></syntax>
<default>30s</default>
<context>stream</context>
<context>server</context>
<appeared-in>1.11.3</appeared-in>

<para>
Sets a timeout for name resolution, for example:
<example>
resolver_timeout 5s;
</example>
<note>
Before version 1.11.3, this directive was available as part of our
<commercial_version>commercial subscription</commercial_version>.
</note>
</para>

</directive>
